summary: The US military struck IRGC missile launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing at least 3, triggering Iranian threats of a heavy retaliatory response. Iran's Khatam Al-Anbiya Headquarters and Armed Forces General Staff vowed overwhelming force against any aggression, while the US continued removing ships from the Strait and Israel conducted strikes on Hamas targets in Gaza. The situation across the Persian Gulf, Lebanon, and Gaza remains highly escalated.
key_points: The US attacked two IRGC missile launchers on Larak Island that were ready to launch missiles with sea mines toward the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @inon_yttach/9980).
Death toll from the US attack on Larak Island rose to 3 after a wounded man died from his wounds (Source: @New_security8200/203504).
Iran's Khatam Al-Anbiya Central Headquarters and Armed Forces General Staff threatened a far heavier response to any attack, warning the US must leave the region (Source: @presstv/204927).
The IRGC stated the enemy's Arab operation will not go unanswered and vowed fierce retaliatory attacks soon (Source: @pkpoi/143784).
Trump stated the US is removing 30 ships per night from the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @N12chat/224330).
IDF eliminated Hamas supply and maintenance commander Amr Muhammad Roshdi Sarag in Tze'rim, Gaza (Source: @New_security8200/203507).
UAE Foreign Ministry reserved full right to respond after the Iranian attack, while electronic jamming was reported over the Persian Gulf (Source: @shin_persian/9253).

Iran's Supreme Court confirmed the death sentence of Ali Asghar Peyghambari, a December 1404 protester, issued by Tehran Revolutionary Court under espionage and collaboration laws (Source: @VahidOnline/78102).

sections.threat_assessment: Iran has explicitly threatened overwhelming retaliatory force against any further US or Israeli aggression, with both its Khatam Al-Anbiya Headquarters and IRGC issuing formal warnings. The US has conducted limited strikes on IRGC positions on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran has demonstrated capability to launch missiles with sea mines toward the strategic waterway. Electronic jamming over the Persian Gulf and interceptions in Jordan's airspace indicate ongoing active hostilities across multiple domains. The situation remains highly volatile with both sides signaling readiness for further escalation.
sections.regional_response: The UAE Foreign Ministry reserved its full right to respond after the Iranian attack, signaling Gulf state alignment against Tehran. Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan agreed to establish a permanent secretariat under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, with Pakistan providing the first secretary-general, reflecting regional security coordination against Iranian threats. Trump stated the US is removing 30 ships per night from the Strait of Hormuz and has ordered Israel's army to be ready. Iran's FM Araghchi engaged diplomatically at the Shanghai Summit, discussing US aggressive attacks and calling for an end to the conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: US officials told Axios that CENTCOM assessed Iran was rebuilding radar, air defense, and anti-ship missile capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz to more accurately target ships, prompting the limited strike on Larak Island. The US approach to reducing Iranian threat to tankers and military assets in the Gulf has been described as 'cutting the grass.' Trump characterized Iran as a 'Failed Nation' with collapsed military and economic structures, though Iranian military institutions including the IRGC and Armed Forces General Staff continue to issue active threat warnings. The discrepancy between claims of Iranian collapse and ongoing operational capabilities warrants continued monitoring.
